sub_graphs.title: Prague: EVM Memory State Transitions
sub_graphs.description: Models the state transitions when memory is read from or written to in the EVM

nodes.label: Memory Idle
nodes.description: EVM memory is in a stable state, waiting for an instruction that accesses memory

nodes.label: Memory Position Popped
nodes.description: Stack values for memory position (and value for writes) have been popped from the stack

nodes.label: Memory Expanded
nodes.description: Memory has been expanded with null bytes to accommodate the requested operation

nodes.label: Memory Written
nodes.description: Data has been written to memory at the specified position

nodes.label: Memory Read Complete
nodes.description: Data has been read from memory and pushed onto the stack

nodes.label: Pop Stack Values
nodes.description: Pop position and (optionally) value from the EVM stack for memory operation

nodes.label: Expand Memory
nodes.description: Expand memory with null bytes if the operation accesses beyond current memory bounds

nodes.label: Write to Memory
nodes.description: Write 1 byte (mstore8), 32 bytes (mstore), or variable bytes (mcopy) to memory

nodes.label: Read from Memory
nodes.description: Read 32 bytes from memory starting at position using memory_read_bytes

nodes.label: Push Result to Stack
nodes.description: Push the read value (mload) or memory size (msize) onto the stack

edges.label: Position and value popped from stack
Memory expanded with null byte padding
Return to idle state after write
Return to idle state after read

sub_graphs.title: Prague: Memory Operation Gas Costs
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas cost calculation for memory operations including base costs and expansion costs

nodes.label: Gas Available for Operation
nodes.description: Current gas available in the EVM execution frame before memory operation

nodes.label: Gas Charged Successfully
nodes.description: Gas has been deducted for the memory operation

nodes.label: Out of Gas
nodes.description: Insufficient gas for the memory operation, execution halts

nodes.label: Calculate Base Gas Cost
nodes.description: Calculate base gas: GAS_VERY_LOW for mstore/mstore8/mload/mcopy, GAS_BASE for msize

nodes.label: Calculate Memory Expansion Cost
nodes.description: Calculate gas cost for expanding memory based on new memory size vs current size

nodes.label: Calculate Copy Cost (mcopy)
nodes.description: Calculate additional gas: GAS_COPY * ceil32(length)/32 for mcopy operation

nodes.label: Charge Gas
nodes.description: Deduct total gas cost from available gas in EVM frame

edges.label: Begin gas calculation for memory operation
Add copy cost if mcopy instruction

sub_graphs.title: Prague: Memory Operation Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation and safety checks for memory operations

nodes.label: Memory Operation Requested
nodes.description: An EVM instruction has requested a memory read or write

nodes.label: Memory Access Valid
nodes.description: Memory access parameters have passed all validation checks

nodes.label: Memory Bounds Adjusted
nodes.description: Memory has been safely expanded to accommodate the access

nodes.label: Validate Position
nodes.description: Check that memory position is a valid U256 value

nodes.label: Validate Length
nodes.description: For mcopy: validate that length is a valid U256 value

nodes.label: Check Memory Bounds
nodes.description: Determine if access exceeds current memory size, triggering expansion

nodes.label: Safe Write via memory_write
nodes.description: Write data using memory_write function which handles bounds safely

nodes.label: Safe Read via memory_read_bytes
nodes.description: Read data using memory_read_bytes function for safe access

ambiguities.text: The behavior when mcopy source and destination ranges overlap is not explicitly specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume mcopy reads all source bytes before writing to destination, handling overlapping ranges correctly (similar to memmove). This needs verification against the implementation.

ambiguities.text: Maximum memory size limits are not explicitly stated in the memory instruction documentation.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume memory expansion is implicitly limited by gas costs and the maximum gas limit per block. Extremely large memory allocations would run out of gas.

implicit_assumptions.description: Memory is always initialized to zero bytes before first use and expanded with zero bytes.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Uninitialized memory could leak data from previous executions or contain garbage values.

implicit_assumptions.description: The memory_write and memory_read_bytes functions correctly handle all edge cases including zero-length operations.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Edge cases in memory access could lead to undefined behavior or memory corruption.

implicit_assumptions.description: Stack values popped for memory operations are valid U256 integers that can represent memory positions.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Invalid stack values could cause integer overflow or underflow in position calculations.
